Takeoff roll.requires: the aircraft accelerating on the runway
Takeoff roll.provides: low energy at the start, rejected takeoff option, runway environment

Climb and cruise.requires: the aircraft airborne away from an airfield
Climb and cruise.provides: altitude and time to respond, remote impact location if uncontained

Approach and landing.provides: high workload, low altitude, little time to recover

Ground handling.requires: the aircraft stationary or taxiing with the engines off or idle
Ground handling.provides: no flight dynamics, ground personnel present, low energy

Mechanical component failure.requires: a part exceeding its capability or life
Mechanical component failure.provides: physical evidence in the wreckage, a design or maintenance origin

Flight crew error.provides: evidence in recorded flight data and cockpit audio, a training or procedure origin

Maintenance error.provides: a documentary trail, physical evidence of incorrect assembly

Weather encounter.provides: meteorological record, no defective part, no incorrect action necessarily

Flight data recorder.provides: aircraft state parameters, no human context

Cockpit voice recorder.requires: a crewed flight deck and recoverable media
Cockpit voice recorder.provides: crew communication and reasoning, nothing about ground activity

Wreckage examination.provides: component condition and failure mode, nothing about intent

Maintenance records.provides: history of intervention, nothing about the flight itself

No injuries.provides: all occupants available for interview, aircraft largely intact

Fatal to some occupants.provides: both survivor accounts and fatal injury evidence

Airworthiness directive.requires: a defect in the type design or a component

No safety recommendation.requires: an isolated cause with no systemic lesson

_v1_notes.OCCURRENCE PHASE|EVIDENCE SOURCE: ground handling is N for both recorders - neither is running meaningfully with the aircraft parked.
_v1_notes.OCCURRENCE PHASE|SURVIVABILITY: ground handling is N for fatal-to-some and N for non-survivable: the energy involved does not reach those outcomes for occupants.
_v1_notes.CAUSAL FACTOR|EVIDENCE SOURCE: mechanical failure is N for the voice recorder as a primary source. Crew error is N for wreckage examination and N for maintenance records. Maintenance error is N for the voice recorder. Weather is N for wreckage and N for maintenance records.
_v1_notes.CAUSAL FACTOR|INVESTIGATION OUTCOME: mechanical failure is N for a training requirement. Crew error is N for an airworthiness directive. Weather is N for an airworthiness directive.
